commits.subject: Add history and notes tools for token-budget sessions (#39827)
evidence: Implemented: new historynotes package mirrors ext/history-notes - a backend calling alpha/history/v2/* and alpha/notes/v2/* endpoints with Codex backend auth (35s timeout, context session_id/current_agent_name injection), nine namespaced tools (history.list_windows/list_items/read_item/search_contents, notes.list_files_by_prefix/read_file/search_contents/append_to_file/write_file) with Rust schemas, argument limits, and parallel gating; wired into toolRouterForTurnContext when features.token_budget.use_history_notes_extension is enabled with an OpenAI provider + Codex backend auth (appserver/runtime_router.go, historynotes/*). Tests added.

commits.subject: Rename the history notes extension config option (#39830)
evidence: Implemented: Go TokenBudgetConfig gains UseHistoryNotesExtension parsed from features.token_budget.use_history_notes_extension; the gate is excluded from explicit-setting detection so model defaults still apply (config/token_budget.go). Tests added.

commits.subject: Ignore project instructions for untrusted projects (#39837)
evidence: Implemented: LoadProjectInstructions skips project-scoped AGENTS.md discovery for untrusted projects while preserving user-level instructions; the instruction cache key includes the trust level so runtime trust changes reload; thread-start wiring resolves the active project trust level from effective config (prompt/instructions.go, appserver/runtime_router.go). Tests added.
